backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. Purely additive: two new tables (guest_companions, guest_companion_history), three new functions, one new private Storage bucket with three RLS policies. No existing table, function, grant or bucket touched. Apply within one hour of the backup or take a new one.

forward_verification.name: guest_companions_rls_enabled
forward_verification.query: select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.guest_companions'::regclass

forward_verification.name: three_functions_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('save_guest_companion_v1','delete_guest_companion_v1','list_guest_companions_v1')

forward_verification.name: bucket_exists_and_private
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from storage.buckets where id = 'guest-id-photos' and public = false)

forward_verification.name: three_storage_policies_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'storage' and tablename = 'objects' and policyname like 'guest id photos%'

forward_verification.name: anon_cannot_call_save_guest_companion
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.save_guest_companion_v1(uuid, uuid, jsonb, integer, text)', 'execute')

rollback.safe_until: any guest_companions row exists; after that delete or migrate them out first. Uploaded storage objects are not auto-deleted.

feature_flags.name: guest_companions_admin_ui
feature_flags.required_state: will be wired into the Guest detail page immediately after this release, in the same session.

compatibility.evidence: Purely additive, new objects only. Not rehearsed on Alfred (no local Docker this session); the migration is transactional and the forward checks run before commit is trusted. ID photo bytes are staff-uploaded directly to the new private bucket from the browser via RLS-gated storage policies (manage_operations), never handled by the agent.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
